_comment: SEC22 item 5, hand-maintained. When audio retention drops a meeting's audio, AudioRetentionSweep rewrites <stem>.embeddings.json from `before` to exactly `after`: every voice vector becomes null, every label key stays (owner recognition and the roster-match record read the keys), and every other key is kept as it was. `labels` is the key set both trees must still see on `after`; `enrollable_before` is the labels carrying a usable vector (a non-empty array) before the strip. Nothing on `after` is enrollable. Swift: MeetingStoreEmbeddingsSEC22Tests and AudioRetentionSweepTests. Python: test_sec22_voiceprints_dropped.py, which runs every Python reader of the file over `after`. Change the writer, run both suites, then edit this file by hand.
